import com.microsoft.spark.sqlanalytics
from com.microsoft.spark.sqlanalytics.Constants import Constants
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, regexp_replace, explode, explode_outer, date_format, to_date, year, to_timestamp

accountName = 'adlsfhirnonprod'
containerName = 'bronze'
relativePath = '30tb'

#years = [2016,2017,2018,2019,2021]
years= [2021]
months = ['01','02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','11']

silverPath = "abfss://silver@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/" + relativePath

obsMainDf = spark.read.format("delta").load(silverPath + "/Observation_main")
claimMainDf = spark.read.format("delta").load(silverPath + "/Claim_main")

obsMainDf = obsMainDf.filter(col("year").isin(years))
claimMainDf = claimMainDf.filter(col("year").isin(years))
obsMainDf = obsMainDf.filter(col("month").isin(months))
claimMainDf = claimMainDf.filter(col("month").isin(months))

import datetime

startDate = datetime.datetime.strptime('2021-12-01', "%Y-%m-%d")
maxDate = datetime.datetime.strptime('2021-12-31', "%Y-%m-%d")
relativePath = '30tb'

obsPath = "abfss://silver@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/" + relativePath + "/Observation_main/year=2021"
claimPath = "abfss://silver@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/" + relativePath + "/Claim_main/year=2021"

while startDate <= maxDate:
    #endDate = startDate + datetime.timedelta(days=7)
    year = 2021
    month = startDate.strftime('%m')
    day = startDate.strftime('%d')

    print("Processing: " + month + " " + day)

    obsMainDf = spark.read.format("delta").load(obsPath + "/month=" + month)
    claimMainDf = spark.read.format("delta").load(claimPath + "/month=" + month)

    obsMainDf = obsMainDf.where(obsMainDf.day == day)
    claimMainDf = claimMainDf.where(claimMainDf.day == day)

    claimMainDf = claimMainDf.withColumnRenamed("use", "isuse")

    (obsMainDf.write
     .option(Constants.SERVER, "wkspc-cdw-nonprod.sql.azuresynapse.net")
     .option(Constants.TEMP_FOLDER, "abfss://silver@adlsfhirnonprod.dfs.core.windows.net/sqlStaging")
     .mode("append")
     .synapsesql("dsqlnonprod.fhir.observationMain"))

    (claimMainDf.write
     .option(Constants.SERVER, "wkspc-cdw-nonprod.sql.azuresynapse.net")
     .option(Constants.TEMP_FOLDER, "abfss://silver@adlsfhirnonprod.dfs.core.windows.net/sqlStaging")
     .mode("append")
     .synapsesql("dsqlnonprod.fhir.claimMain"))
    
    startDate = startDate + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
